jobs.title: Front Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Claremont Resort & Club, we believe that exceptional hospitality starts with extraordinary people. For over a century, our iconic resort has set the standard for luxury and service in the Bay Area. We take pride in creating memorable experiences for our guests—and a rewarding, inclusive workplace for our colleagues. Situated on 22 acres in the Berkeley and Oakland Hills, Claremont Resort & Club seamlessly blends its rich 19th-century history with the modern day to offer the very best of the Bay Area. Guests dine with friends at Limewood, relax at our urban oasis, The Spa at the Claremont, and discover total wellness at The Club at the Claremont- all while taking in the breathtaking views of the San Francisco Bay.

Don't meet every single requirement of this job? At HEI we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still send in your information. You may be the perfect candidate for this or for other roles within our organization!  
  
We value U.S. military experience and invite all qualified military candidates to apply.

**Compensation**

Salary Range: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 AnnuallyTipped/Service Charge Eligible? NoDiscretionary Performance Bonus Eligible? No

**Overview**

Ensure guest service standards of the guest arrival, departure, and any other guest contact experience are met through optimal training, staffing, and supervision of labor, efficient management of operating supplies, and proactive monitoring of guest service scores and comments.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Ensure efficient guest registration, checkout, guest service, and telephone service, while ensuring all brand standards are being applied.
* Implement company and franchise programs.
* Prepare forecasts and reports and assist in the development of the room’s budget.
* Monitor and maintain the front office systems and equipment to ensure their optimum performance.
* Track guest satisfaction surveys and maximize usage of the guest response tracking system.
* Develop and implement controls for expense management. Utilize labor management tools to schedule and control labor costs.
* Interview, hire, train, develop, resolve problems, provide open communication, and recommend discipline and/or termination when appropriate of staff members. Ensure timely completion of performance appraisals.
* Communicate both verbally and in writing to provide clear direction to staff.
* Interact positively with customers and take action to resolve problems to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction and quality.
* Ensure compliance of front office, guest service, and PBX standard operating procedures and policies. Ensure all Front Office Quality Standards are complied with and are consistently applied.
* Coordinate activities with other hotel departments in order to facilitate increased levels of communication and guest satisfaction.
* Assist in the daily maintenance of room inventory status to achieve optimal levels of revenues while maintaining high levels of guest expectations.
* Resolve customer complaints; anticipate potential problems by reviewing and monitoring complaints, operational issues, business flow and associate performance to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and quality.
* Develop strong relations with the sales team to discuss and implement sales strategies to continually improve occupancy levels and revenues.
* Regular attendance in conformance with the standards is essential to the successful performance of this position.
* Comply with attendance rules and be available to work on a regular basis.
* Perform any other job-related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Minimum of 2 years Front Desk experience, preferably in leadership role.
* Proficient with PMS system.
* Advanced knowledge of brand’s reward program.
* Able to handle cash and credit transactions.
* Computer literacy and financial management a must.
* Able to effectively deal with internal and external customers, some of whom will require high level of patience, tact and diplomacy to defuse anger and collect accurate information and resolve conflicts.
* General knowledge of local area attractions and transportation.
* Able to observe and detect signs of emergency situations. Able to remain calm and alert, during emergency situations and/or heavy hotel activity, serving as a role model for clerks and other associates.
* Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws governing equal employment opportunity and civil rights, occupational safety and health, wage and hour issues and labor relations, including, but not limited to the following statues and their comparable state and local laws.
* Able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with associates and customers.
* Able to make sound business decisions and take action quickly based on previous experience and good judgment.
* Knowledge of hotel operations, including marketing plans, security and safety programs, personnel and labor relations, preparation of business plans, repairs, maintenance, budget forecasting, quality assurance programs, hospitality law, and long-range planning.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to adapt communication style to suit different audiences, such as effectively communicating with supervisors, coworkers, public etc.

**Benefits**

HEI Hotels and Resorts is committed to providing a comprehensive benefit program that offers you choices for your physical, mental and financial wellness, creating value in your most important investment - you!  
  
For your physical and mental wellness we offer competitive Medical and Dental programs through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield as well as Vision insurance programs through EyeMed. Our Vacation, Sick and Holiday programs are available for you to rejuvenate

jobs.title: Client Services Representative
jobs.description:
**Client Service Representative (CSR)**
=======================================

**Montclair Pet Hospital | Oakland, CA**  
**Full-time | $22–$28 per hour**  
**Monday–Thursday | Four 10-hour shifts | 7:30 am–6:00 pm**

**At Montclair Pet Hospital, we believe pets and people deserve better care.**

We're looking for a friendly, compassionate and organised **Client Service Representative (CSR)** to join our team in the heart of Oakland's Montclair neighbourhood.

As the first point of contact for our clients and their pets, you'll play an important role in creating a welcoming, reassuring experience from the moment they walk through our doors or pick up the phone.

You'll be joining a collaborative veterinary team that values great communication, teamwork and delivering thoughtful, personalised care. Whether you're helping a client schedule an appointment, answering questions or supporting the team during a busy day, you'll make a real difference to the people and pets who rely on us.

**And that support goes further.** As part of VetnCare, you'll be connected to a wider community of veterinary professionals, shared expertise and a dedicated Community Support Team, giving you the resources and support to build a rewarding career.

**What You Can Expect at Montclair**
------------------------------------

* **A fantastic work-life balance:** Enjoy a consistent Monday–Thursday schedule, working four 10-hour shifts, with Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays off.
* **A welcoming, collaborative team:** Work alongside four veterinarians, three Registered Veterinary Technicians, five Veterinary Assistants and fellow client service colleagues.
* **A community-focused hospital:** Build meaningful relationships with clients and their pets, helping them feel supported throughout their veterinary experience.
* **A great Oakland location:** Situated in the heart of Montclair, with restaurants, cafés and shops within walking distance.
* **Opportunities to discover your potential:** Develop your client service skills, gain valuable veterinary industry experience and continue learning from those around you.
* **A team grounded in shared values:** Work together, stay curious, speak up and look for better ways to care for pets, support clients and help one another.

**Your Role**

As a Client Service Representative, you'll be at the heart of the client experience, helping our hospital run smoothly while ensuring every pet and person feels welcome and cared for.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Welcome clients and their pets, creating a warm, professional and positive first impression.
* Answer incoming calls, respond to enquiries and provide helpful, compassionate customer service.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, helping clients navigate their pets' care.
* Recognise urgent concerns and promptly communicate them to the appropriate veterinary team member.
* Maintain accurate client and patient information, ensuring records are updated appropriately.
* Support clear communication between clients, veterinarians and the wider hospital team.
* Help manage the flow of appointments and keep the reception area organised and welcoming.
* Handle client questions and concerns with empathy, professionalism and a solutions-focused approach.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure a smooth and positive experience for clients and patients, even during busy periods.

**What Better Care Means for You**
----------------------------------

* **$22–$28 per hour**, depending on experience
* **Four-day working week**, with a consistent schedule and three-day weekends
* Shared **impact bonus** linked to hospital profitability
* Generous discounts on veterinary care for teammate pets, plus free clinical exams (exclusions apply)
* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance, including virtual care
* **401(k)** with a 100% company match up to 4%
* Health and Dependent Care FSA/HSA accounts
* Employer-paid life and AD&D insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage
* Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, financial and family support services
* Access to the Calm app and Talkspace therapy services
* Paid time off, sick leave and paid holidays
* Opportunities for continued learning, development and career growth
* Annual engagement surveys, giving you a voice in shaping our workplace
* Annual team celebration and recognition events

**The Right Fit**
-----------------

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, takes pride in delivering excellent customer service and thrives as part of a supportive team.

You'll ideally bring:

* Previous customer service experience, ideally in a busy, client-facing environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a warm and approachable manner.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Confidence answering calls, handling enquiries and providing a positive client experience.
* A compassionate and patient approach, particularly when supporting clients during emotional or stressful situations.
* Good attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate information.
* A collaborative mindset, a positive attitude and a willingness to learn.
* Availability to work **Monday–Thursday, 7:30 am–6:00 pm**.

**Previous veterinary experience would be an advantage, but it's not essential.** We're particularly interested in finding someone with the right attitude, strong customer service skills and a genuine interest in helping pets and their people.

**About VetnCare**
------------------

VetnCare is a community of veterinary hospitals across Northern California, united by a shared belief that pets and people deserve better care.

You will keep agreements, staffing changes and purchase order (PO) funding aligned, and own the research, supplier communication and follow-through needed to resolve issues. jobs.title: Manager, New Verticals - Pharmacy Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce through expanding our product offerings on our marketplace platform. We launched in 2020 and have since then built world-class operations to delight our customers with access to Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Pharmacy and Retail delivery through our marketplace. We focus on building new businesses and scale them - this team is focused on building our Pharmacy business from the ground up.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Manager on the Pharmacy Strategy & Operations team, you will own the growth and merchant engine for DoorDash's Pharma business. You will build and execute the go-to-market plan that brings pharmacy merchants onto DoorDash, grows their volume, and keeps them. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and New Verticals platform teams to be successful.

You'll be responsible for turning the pharmacy opportunity into a repeatable motion: planning and launching GTM programs, pitching and negotiating with merchants, and shaping how we speak to returning customers about pharmacy on DoorDash. You are the owner for knowing how Pharma merchants are performing, where the funnel leaks, and where to place the next bet to drive growth. You turn targets into operating plans, and plans into measurable outcomes.

This role requires strong commercial instincts and comfort with data. You should move fluently between merchant-level detail and business-level economics, build frameworks for tradeoffs and prioritization, and familiarity with modeling different scenarios and outcomes. Experience using SQL and data visualization tools is a plus.

You will report into the GM of Pharmacy S&O and be an individual contributor, with the opportunity to build a team in the future.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize.** From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
* **Operate.** Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
* **Analyze.** Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
* **Experiment.** You'll transform strategies into operational experiments, product features and net-new tooling that create measurable outcomes.
* **Build with AI.** You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
* **Lead, collaborate and Influence.** You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* **You have 6-8+ years of experience.** You've succeeded in similar cultures that are highly analytical and cross-functional (whether in tech, e-commerce, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience). Merchant-facing or healthcare/pharmacy experience is a plus.
* **You are an owner.** You're always looking for opportunities to better your work product and own the outcome – both the good and the bad.
* **You're entrepreneurial.** You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
* **You're analytical.** You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling your own data in SQL, building models, and building the tools you need to create 10x outcomes.
* **You are AI Native.** You root cause problems with a systems first approach and can identify how to automate repeatable tasks using AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini or Copilot.
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.
* **You're a persuasive communicator.** You can pitch and negotiate with senior merchant stakeholders and align internal partners around a plan.
* **You're unafraid of ambiguity.** Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in an ambiguous, startup environment.
* **You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.** MBA is a plus!

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction.

The ***Operations Manager*** is responsible for establishing and executing company strategy related to domestic freight movements through an understanding of industry trends and best practices. AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. jobs.description:
Hubble Network was founded with the intention of delivering on the promise of what Internet-of-Things (IoT) was supposed to be. We're building a global Bluetooth® network dedicated to machine-to-machine connectivity. We differentiate ourselves as the first modem-less and gateway-less, direct-to-satellite network from off-the-shelf Bluetooth® Low Energy chips. Hubble is ideal for applications in logistics, AgTech, and maritime where economies of scale for volume consumer and enterprise asset tracking is a priority. Our goal is to be the first billion-endpoint-connected network in the world.

Hubble is an early-stage, venture-backed startup supported by some of the best investors in the world. In their previous lives, the founding team has been successful in raising $100s of millions in venture funding, developing the Amazon Sidewalk network, launching billions of dollars of space assets, and leading their teams to successful exits, both through acquisition and IPO. **Job Description:**

The Quality Manager plays a critical role in driving operational excellence by capturing, validating, and analyzing key performance data to ensure real-time visibility and alignment across the operation. **Why This Role Matters:**

This position directly addresses a critical gap in our operation. By ensuring real time KPI visibility and reinforcing data accountability at all levels, the Quality Manager enables faster decision making, operational alignment, and strategic clarity. This role also ensures long-term resilience by serving as a backup to the current reporting function and helping to build a culture of data driven performance.

Alliance Ground International (AGI) is one of the largest independently owned ground handling companies providing services to 100+ airlines in 61 airports across the U.S. and Canada. We are the home to over 12,000 team members supporting over 1.5B Kilos and over 400K departures. We are committed to providing the highest quality service and continuing our outstanding safety track record. As we continue to grow, we only look for the best in the industry.

* Must be able to sit for long periods.

jobs.title: Commercial Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of Project Manager who can turn chaos into coordination, problems into solutions, and a complicated flooring installation into a job well done?

If you're nodding your head, we need to talk!

At Profloors, we're not just in the flooring business. We're in the business of building relationships, delivering exceptional results, and making our partners' lives Bigger, Better, and Brighter!

We're looking for an experienced, motivated, and highly organized Commercial Flooring Project Manager to join our Hayward team. This role combines estimating, sales, and project management, with responsibility for developing opportunities, preparing accurate bids, winning work, and managing projects through completion.

This isn't a position for someone who simply checks boxes and watches the clock. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates challenges, builds relationships, and takes pride in seeing a project through from beginning to end.

If you know commercial flooring, enjoy building customer relationships and winning new business, and love the satisfaction of a successful installation, you might just be our next Proflooristic superstar!

What You'll Be Doing

As our Commercial Flooring Project Manager, you'll guide customers from the initial site visit and estimate through proposal approval, installation, and final walkthrough. You'll be responsible for growing sales while ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the high standards our customers expect.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Estimate Accurately: Conduct site visits, measure spaces, review plans and specifications, and prepare material takeoffs and estimates that account for labor, materials, prep, waste, freight, and site conditions.
* Build Complete Proposals: Obtain supplier and subcontractor pricing, confirm product availability and lead times, and prepare clear proposals with scope, exclusions, and project requirements.
* Grow Sales: Develop new business through sales stops, prospecting, referrals, and outreach to property managers, general contractors, and other commercial customers while expanding existing accounts.
* Follow Through and Close: Present flooring solutions, follow up consistently on proposals, address customer questions, and secure written approvals before moving projects into production.
* Keep Your Pipeline Current: Maintain accurate customer contacts, opportunity stages, and next steps in the CRM so every active opportunity has a clear follow-up plan.
* Own Your Projects: Oversee commercial flooring projects from initial opportunity and estimating through installation and final walkthrough.
* Keep Everything Moving: Coordinate installers, customers, internal teams, and schedules to ensure projects run smoothly.
* Be the Problem Solver: Identify potential obstacles, resolve jobsite challenges, and keep projects on track.
* Protect the Bottom Line: Develop competitive pricing that meets company profitability expectations, monitor project costs, and document scope changes and change orders for approval before additional work proceeds.
* Deliver Quality: Conduct in-progress inspections and final walkthroughs to ensure workmanship meets our expectations.
* Build Relationships: Maintain strong communication with customers, address concerns promptly, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Keep Everyone in the Loop: Partner with our administrative team to ensure project notes, orders, and updates are accurate and timely.
* Finish Strong: Take pride in completing projects successfully and creating customers who want to work with Profloors again.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

We're looking for someone who brings more than experience to the table. We want someone who brings initiative, accountability, and a genuine passion for getting things done right.

Here's what you'll need:

* At least one year of flooring industry experience, with a solid understanding of flooring products and installation processes.
* At least one year of project management experience, preferably in commercial flooring or a closely related construction environment.
* Hands-on estimating experience, including site measurements, plan reading, material takeoffs, and labor and material cost calculations.
* Sales and business development experience, with the ability to build relationships, present proposals, follow up consistently, and close profitable work.
* Proficiency with estimating software and CRM tools; experience with Measure Square, M2, or Pipedrive is a plus.
* Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency is a plus but not required.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to make decisions, solve problems, and remain professional under pressure.
* A valid driver's license and a clean driving record.
* A customer-first mindset and a commitment to quality workmanship.

And just as important, we're looking for someone who:

* Takes accountability instead of making excuses.
* Communicates proactively rather than waiting for someone to ask.
* Understands that details matter and follow-through is everything.
* Treats customers, coworkers, and installers with professionalism and respect.
* Can work independently while recognizing that teamwork makes everyone more successful.
* Brings solutions to the table, not just problems.

What's in It for You?

At Profloors, we believe great employees deserve a great place to work.

Here's what we offer:

* Competitive Annual Salary: $65,000–$75,000.
* Commission Opportunity: After 90 days, eligibility for 2% commission on qualifying commercial projects independently sold, managed, and closed.
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance.
* Paid Vacation and Sick Leave.
* A Team-Oriented Environment: Work alongside people who care about doing things right.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, technically demanding construction projects across advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, and other specialized markets.

This is an opportunity for an established construction leader who enjoys taking ownership of challenging projects, leading high-performing teams, building strong client relationships, and delivering exceptional results. Ideal candidates will bring experience managing large-scale projects or multiple smaller projects in environments such as advanced technology facilities, semiconductor manufacturing, data centers, life sciences laboratories, pharmaceutical facilities, hospitals, medical centers, and other complex institutional or technical projects.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will have direct responsibility for all aspects of one large, complex project or multiple small-to-mid-sized projects. You will lead projects through every phase of the construction lifecycle, including estimating, purchasing, engineering, accounting, construction, safety, and quality assurance.

This role requires strong technical knowledge, sound business judgment, advanced problem-solving abilities, and the ability to identify and mitigate project risks. Equally important is the ability to develop, mentor, and lead project teams while building lasting relationships with clients, design partners, and key trade partners.

* Experience overseeing complex construction projects from preconstruction through completion.

By mid-morning, you refine a Smartsheet Gantt plan to reconcile bottom-up engineering tasks with top-down program gates. After lunch, you drive a Jira triage to unblock an HV component validation issue and coordinate an ECO to keep the BOM aligned with the latest prototype. You close the day by summarizing KPIs and milestone health for engineering leadership—schedule fidelity, cost-down progress, component maturity—and flag a risk with supplier lead times, along with your mitigation plan.

**Impact You’ll Own**
---------------------

* Guide HV/LV electromechanical system development end-to-end—from requirements and reviews through prototyping, validation, ramp, and mass production.
* Build and continuously update integrated schedules, mapping engineering deliverables to program milestones and interdependencies.
* Enable execution across mechanical, electrical, test, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain; identify risks and drive resolution.
* Lead cost-reduction and quality-improvement initiatives; manage component maturity plans throughout the lifecycle.
* Anticipate and remove roadblocks; course-correct quickly as priorities shift or technical challenges emerge.
* Develop and present KPIs, readouts, and executive updates to keep leadership aligned and informed.
* Own component-level timelines and align bottom-up activities with top-down objectives.
* Maintain accountability via Jira—ensuring action items, issues, and mitigations are tracked to closure.
* Orchestrate product releases: engineering changes (ECR/ECO), component readiness, and BOM integrity.

* 5+ years in technical program management or adjacent roles within high-voltage batteries, electric vehicles, powertrain, energy storage, robotics, or similar hardware.
* End-to-end product development experience—from design and validation through manufacturing ramp and volume build.
* Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional schedules, dependencies, and critical-path execution.
* Working knowledge of multilevel BOMs, mechanical/electrical structures, and component dependencies.

**JOB** **TITLE****:** Project Manager 3  
**FLSA:** Exempt position  
**LOCATION**: Fremont, CA (Onsite)  
**SALARY**: $85,000 - $130,000

  

**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Project Manager (Level 3) serves as a technical and execution lead across multiple manufacturing projects, providing direction, expertise, and problem-solving leadership in complex or high-impact situations. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, drives alignment across cross-functional teams, and supports Program Managers by translating strategic objectives into executable plans. Level 3 Project Managers are trusted advisors on project execution and actively guide and coach junior Project Managers to strengthen overall team performance.

  

The Program Management (PM) team plays a critical role in overseeing manufacturing projects from initial launch through mass production and final shipment. Functioning as a Manufacturing Program Management (MPM) organization, the team works closely with headquarters Sales, R&D, Quality, and Engineering teams to estimate resources, manage schedules, and align execution with customer requirements. The PM team coordinates cross-functional activities, balances customer commitments with internal efficiency, and adapts plans as conditions change. By serving as a key bridge between customers, headquarters, and manufacturing functions, the team supports timely execution and successful product delivery.

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations teams.

* Lead execution of multiple projects concurrently, including complex Mass Production (MP) and/or New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives.

* Provide technical and execution leadership by defining project strategies, timelines, and risk mitigation plans.

* Identify systemic risks, resource constraints, and interdependencies across projects; recommend and implement corrective actions.

* Serve as an escalation point for project issues, leading root cause analysis and recovery planning.

* Lead critical project meetings and reviews, ensuring clear decision-making, accountability, and follow-through.

* Support customer- and headquarters-facing discussions as needed, providing execution insight and feasibility input.

* Partner closely with Program Managers to support program-level planning, prioritization, and execution strategy.

* Provide hands-on guidance, coaching, and mentorship to Level 1 and Level 2 Project Managers, including review of schedules, risk plans, and communications.

* Contribute to the continuous improvement of project management standards, tools, and best practices across the PM team.

**COMPETENCIES:**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing project lifecycles and cross-functional dependencies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects independently with minimal oversight.
* Strong execution judgment with the ability to balance competing priorities and make timely decisions.
* Excellent leadership, influence, and stakeholder management skills without formal authority.
* Advanced problem-solving and risk management capabilities.
* Strong mentoring and coaching skills with a track record of developing junior team members.
* Clear, confident communication skills suitable for senior stakeholders and cross-functional leadership.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
* 5–7 years of experience in project or program management within manufacturing, engineering, or operations environments.
* Proven experience leading multiple concurrent projects and mentoring less-experienced Project Managers.

jobs.description:
Patient & Family Care Coordinator

**Part-Time | Tuesday–Thursday**  
**Flourish Airway Collective | Danville, California**

Help children breathe, sleep, grow—and flourish.

Flourish Airway Collective is looking for an exceptionally warm, organized, and dependable person to become the welcoming heart of our practice.

This is not a traditional front-desk position. Our Patient & Family Care Coordinator will guide families through their Flourish experience—from the first phone call through treatment and follow-up. The right person will genuinely love connecting with children and their parents, take pride in remembering the little details, and make every family feel seen, supported, and confident in their care.

At Flourish, we help infants, toddlers, children, and adolescents with concerns that may affect their breathing, sleep, feeding, speech, dental development, and overall well-being. Our services include evaluation and treatment of tethered oral tissues, such as tongue-ties and lip-ties, as well as early orthodontic expansion to create more space for the teeth and tongue and support healthy airway development.

Our work can be life-changing for children—and we want every family’s experience with us to feel just as exceptional as the care they receive.

**Who You Are**

You are naturally warm, reassuring, and wonderful with both children and adults. Parents feel comfortable asking you questions because you listen carefully, communicate clearly, and never make them feel rushed or dismissed.

You are also highly detail-oriented. You notice what needs to be done, follow through without repeated reminders, and understand that small details matter—especially when families are navigating unfamiliar treatment.

You bring both heart and ownership to your work. You do not simply complete tasks; you make sure each family is truly taken care of.

**What You’ll DoCreate an Exceptional Family Experience**

* Warmly welcome children and parents when they arrive
* Help children feel comfortable, safe, and excited to visit Flourish
* Build genuine relationships with parents and caregivers
* Anticipate families’ needs and make each visit feel personal and organized
* Serve as a consistent, trusted point of contact throughout treatment
* Create thoughtful touches that make families feel especially cared for

**Communicate With Warmth and Confidence**

* Answer incoming phone calls with warmth, patience, and professionalism
* Listen carefully to parents’ questions and concerns
* Clearly explain what families can expect at upcoming appointments
* Become well trained in Flourish services, terminology, and treatment pathways
* Know when to answer a question, when to gather additional information, and when to involve a clinical team member
* Return calls, texts, and emails promptly and reliably
* Communicate in a way that is friendly, polished, compassionate, and easy to understand

**Coordinate Patient Care**

* Schedule consultations, treatment appointments, and follow-up visits accurately
* Help families understand the next steps in their child’s care
* Confirm that required forms, records, photographs, referrals, and other information are received
* Track outstanding tasks and follow up until they are fully completed
* Coordinate communication with pediatricians, ENTs, myofunctional therapists, speech therapists, lactation consultants, and other collaborative providers
* Prepare and organize patient materials, referral information, and educational resources
* Help prevent families from getting lost between appointments or stages of care

**Support the Growth of Flourish**

* Maintain accurate, organized patient records and tracking systems
* Assist with correspondence, letters, reports, and follow-up communication
* Help deliver educational materials or thoughtful packages to referring offices and community partners
* Support outreach efforts and relationships with local healthcare providers
* Look for ways to improve the family experience and practice systems
* Step in wherever needed to help Flourish run smoothly and beautifully

**What We’re Looking For**

* An exceptionally warm and welcoming personality
* A genuine love of children and appreciation for the parents who care for them
* Experience working with children, parents, or families
* Excellent phone presence and confident interpersonal communication
* Strong attention to detail and an unusually high level of follow-through
* The ability to learn new concepts and explain them clearly
* Emotional intelligence, good judgment, and discretion
* A calm, reassuring presence when parents feel worried or overwhelmed
* Strong written communication and organizational skills
* Comfort managing multiple priorities without losing track of details
* Initiative and the ability to recognize what needs to be done
* Reliability, accountability, and pride in doing things well
* A collaborative, positive, and team-oriented attitude
* Comfort receiving feedback and continually improving

**Especially Valuable Experience**

We would be particularly excited to meet candidates who have:

* Worked in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, pediatrics, therapy, education, childcare, hospitality, or another family-centered setting
* Experience guiding parents through healthcare, educational, or developmental services
* Professional or lived experience that provides a deep understanding of the questions, emotions, and logistics caregivers navigate
* Experience with treatment coordination, scheduling, patient communication, or referral relationships
* An interest in children’s breathing, sleep, feeding, speech, oral development, or whole-child health
* Experience with community outreach or building relationships with professional offices

Dental experience is helpful but not required. Warmth, judgment, curiosity, attention to detail, and follow-through are essential. We are happy to teach the clinical information to someone who is eager to learn and deeply committed to our fam

jobs.title: Manager, GMP Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Yowei Therapeutics and Yowei Oncology are stealth-stage life-sciences companies working closely with CSBio to advance peptide-based clinical programs. Their work spans longevity and peptide therapeutics, clinical trials, evaluation of a 503A pharmacy model, personalized synthetic neoantigen peptide oncology programs, and supporting microbiology and laboratory capabilities. Together, they are building the clinical, pharmacy, data, laboratory, and operational infrastructure needed to responsibly translate peptide programs into patient-facing studies and services. Both companies expect to remain in stealth through Q1 2027.

CSBio is a peptide contract manufacturing founded in 1993. CSBio initial products were a complete line of automated synthesizers for manufacturing and process development, with a focus on cGMP production. In 1994, CSBio opened a custom peptide facility and began producing high quality compounds for research organizations and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. In 2004, CSBio opened a peptide production facility in Menlo Park, CA and in 2014, CSBio expanded production capability through the addition of a new, state of the art building dedicated to cGMP peptide production. In 2017, CSBio passed a FDA inspection and were recommended to be approved for commercial drug substance manufacturing. In 2023, additional cGMP clinical production capacity was added in Milpitas, CA.

Yowei is seeking a hands-on Quality Assurance Manager to supervise daily QA activities supporting peptide manufacturing, laboratory operations, materials, documentation, and cGMP compliance. This person will manage QA staff and directly support document review, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness. Core duties and responsibilities include the following:

Job Duties:

* Supervise daily QA work, assign priorities, review completion, train staff, and provide practical guidance on cGMP documentation and quality-system requirements.
* Review executed batch records, laboratory records, equipment and cleaning records, logbooks, labels, and supporting documentation for completeness and compliance.
* Manage or support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, nonconformances, complaints, and effectiveness checks; ensure actions are documented and completed on time.
* Coordinate document control, SOP issuance, periodic review, archival, forms, templates, and controlled-copy practices.
* Support employee training assignments, completion tracking, qualification records, and documentation of GMP readiness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, QC, Materials, Facilities, Validation, Regulatory, and management to resolve quality issues and prevent avoidable delays.
* Provide QA review and approval of validation plans, risk assessments, protocols, reports, and qualification documentation for facilities, utilities, equipment, processes, cleaning, analytical methods, and software systems.
* Work with system owners to maintain a practical validation assessment plan and address gaps in current or legacy validation documentation using documented risk-based decisions.
* Support supplier qualification, material-status decisions, quality agreements, vendor documentation, and supplier corrective actions as assigned.
* Manage or support customer-complaint investigations and approved recall or product-withdrawal procedures, including documentation, reconciliation, and authorized notifications.
* Conduct or coordinate internal audits, floor observations, documentation reviews, and follow-up of findings.
* Prepare QA records and subject-matter experts for customer audits and regulatory inspections; track requests, responses, observations, and commitments.
* Monitor practical QA metrics such as overdue investigations, CAPAs, change controls, document reviews, training, batch-record review, and recurring documentation errors.
* Escalate product-quality, patient-safety, data-integrity, compliance, and release risks promptly to authorized Quality leadership.
* Improve QA workflows, templates, training, and quality-system usability without transferring QC laboratory or Manufacturing ownership into QA.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years of Quality Assurance or closely related cGMP experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, peptide, API, sterile, medical-device, or other regulated manufacturing.
* 2+ years of supervisory, lead, or functional-management experience, including work assignment, training, review, and employee development.
* Hands-on experience with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, training, batch-record review, audits, and inspection readiness.
* Working knowledge of cGMP documentation, data integrity, traceability, quality risk, and cross-functional escalation.
* Working knowledge of applicable FDA and ICH expectations and risk-based validation practices.
* Strong judgment, written communication, investigation, organization, and follow-through skills.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (Kaiser HMO or BlueShield PPO. Employer pays 85% for Employee and 50% for Employee’s family; Dental: Aetna Dental, Delta Dental, Guardian Dental, MetLife Dental. Vision: VSP and Aetna EyeMed)
* Basic life ($20,000 paid by company) and supplemental life insurance (optional supplemental).
* Disability insurance 50% standard employer paid.
* 401k 10% 1:1 match
* PTO policy. 10 days PTO
* Companywide paid holiday during: Week of July 4, Thanksgiving (2 days), Week of December 25
* Carpool, clean air vehicle, and cell phone reimbursement
* Employee rewards and recognition program
* Company organized social events
* Quarterly sponsored team building activities

This is a **senior-level Human Resources role** responsible for providing advanced HR expertise and guidance across complex employee and organizational matters. The position develops, implements, administers, and evaluates HR policies, programs, procedures, and labor contract requirements across multiple functional areas.

Serving as a **technical leader and subject matter expert** , the individual independently analyzes and resolves highly complex or unique HR issues that may have limited precedent or established guidance. Human Resources is committed to providing an outstanding customer experience, prioritizing workforce strategies, creating an engaging environment focused on continuous improvement for the HR team, and demonstrating value to the organization.

jobs.title: ABA Therapy Program Manager
jobs.description:
The program supervisor serves in the field as the manager responsible for the case, mastering daily case management skills, including developing and overseeing clinical programs, supervising Behavior Technicians, and providing education and training for client caregivers. The Program Manager will provide clinical skills instruction and behavior reduction protocols based upon the principles of Applied Behavior Analysis to children with Autism and related developmental disabilities in the home, community, school, and clinic settings. The Program Manager will collect data on programs, assist with parent training, and implement programs developed by a Board Certified Behavior Analyst which are individualized for each client.  
  
Essential components of this position are listed below but are subject to change at the discretion of Behavior Nation LLC. This job description describes essential job functions but does not provide an exhaustive list of duties that may be assigned.  
  
**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Deliver clear, concise, constructive, and actionable communications, insights, and feedback to staff and client families with professionalism, HR-compliant language, and a spirit of customer service.
* Efficiently produce each client’s clinical programs, reports, and other supervision documents accurately and completely in compliance with contracted (billable) hours.
* Directly supervise, train, and support BIs, from entry-level to advanced, to successfully exhibit the necessary confidence and authority to build rapport with families and conduct effective sessions from Day 1, regardless of, and in alignment with, their personal level of experience.
* Provide coverage for peers during their absences and provide direct therapy to clients if the BI is absent and other coverage is not available.
* Respect the time of colleagues and client families by maintaining a punctual, consistent, reliable schedule, and inspiring others to reflect the same attitude and share the commitment.
* Provide training and ongoing support to caregivers and family members tailored to support their communication, learning styles, and cultural needs.
* Maintain professional, regular, and effective (timely and accurate) communication with client families and all colleagues (administrative and clinical).
* Produce clinical and administrative duties and paperwork with accuracy and timeliness and in compliance with the contracted (billable) hours allotted.
* With a spirit of leadership and teamwork, attend and lead the clinical team and training meetings.
* Comply with the company’s policies, procedures, timelines, and budgets.
* Assist in the effective development and delivery of ABA and other services as needed by their supervisor and area director.

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Self‐disciplined: Able to schedule and attend client appointments and clinical team meetings with consistency, reliability, and punctuality.
* Excellent written and spoken communication: Clear language, accurate grammar, and spelling.
* Excellent time management skills: Understands how to allocate working days between billable hours and non-billable hours, onsite (direct) and in‐office (indirect) supervision hours.

jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.  
  
The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.  
  
The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.  
  
Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.  
  
Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

### **The Role**

Own technical enablement end to end for our presales Solutions Architects (SAs) and post-sales Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs) — the single person accountable for the field's technical readiness. You own onboarding and ramp, feature launch enablement, golden demo paths, the demo environment, certification, and the content and metrics that hold it together, so the whole field can represent the platform accurately and win on technical merit. It's a dedicated role, not a side-of-desk task.

**How You'll Make and Impact**
------------------------------

* **Onboarding & ramp.** Replace the static checklist with a guided 30/60/90 path — recorded modules, documentation, and hands-on labs — that gets every new SA and CSE to certified field-readiness, independent of who mentors them.
* **Launch enablement.** Run a tiered cadence sized to launch impact, with a standing cross-functional SME working group, so every GA release reaches the field at the right depth, on time, with spaced reinforcement that makes it stick.

* **Certification & competency.** Define what "good" looks like across levels, certify readiness rather than assume it, gate solo customer-facing moments on it, and coach the field toward the next level with structured feedback.
* **Content & measurement.** Keep one source of truth current by default, and report ramp time, launch coverage, certification, and PoV technical-win conversion against a baseline.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

* 5+ years in technical enablement, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical product marketing — ideally having both carried a technical field role and built programs for one.
* A strong technical foundation in application security, software supply chain security, or developer tooling (SCA, SAST / AI code security, CI/CD, integrations) — enough to earn field credibility and translate capability into field-ready assets.
* Fluency with the technical sales motion: discovery, demos, PoVs / PoCs, value/ROI and competitive positioning.
* A builder's instinct for instructional design and reusable content — build once, use many — plus the program management to run a cadence across Product, PMM, Engineering, and the field.
* A track record of turning complex product capability into clear, practical enablement, and measuring whether it worked.

### **Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience owning a demo/lab environment and an LMS or enablement platform.
* Familiarity with call analytics (e.g., Gong) and CRM / PoV data for measuring field impact.
* Experience standing up a certification or competency program from scratch.
* Background selling or supporting security tooling to security and engineering leaders.

**What We Offer You**
---------------------

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans.
* 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.
* Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)
* Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.
* A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.

jobs.title: Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
Beginnings matter. Whether someone is starting their career or joining a new company, their early experiences shape how quickly they find their footing and how far they can go. A great beginning gives people the context, skills, and confidence to do their best work.

As our **Emerging Talent & Onboarding Program Manager,** you’ll own that moment for nearly everyone who joins Mercury, across new hire onboarding, internships, and a new apprenticeship program. You’ll think as deeply about the experience people have as the systems behind the scenes that make it all work, and you’ll be a visible face of Mercury when people need support most. You’ll build programs that feel distinctly Mercury, using AI and your creativity to rethink how they work from the ground up.

* *Mercury is a financial technology company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.*

### **Here are some things you’ll do on the job:**

* **Run new hire onboarding.** Own the program end to end: the learning arc, facilitator coordination, cohort communications, and feedback. Partner with People Operations on preboarding so the experience starts before day one and every new hire’s first weeks feel useful and welcoming.
* **Launch our new apprenticeship program.** Design and own program operations and the apprentice experience: cohort programming, exec exposure, check-ins at each rotation, and partnerships with host teams.
* **Strengthen our internship program.** Build on what teams already run with a shared company-wide experience for interns, including onboarding, community, regular check-ins, and a clear point of contact.
* **Support managers and mentors.** Give the people hosting new hires, interns, and apprentices clear expectations and the resources to do it well.
* **Build the systems behind the programs.** Use AI, automation, and tooling to reimagine what each program can do, keep quality high as hiring grows, and adapt as the technology evolves. Use feedback and data to see what’s working and improve it.
* **Tell the story of emerging talent.** Partner with Recruiting, People Operations, and leaders across Mercury to show how we invest in people early in their careers.

### **You should:**

* Have **3–5 years of experience** building and running programs, ideally in Learning & Development, People programs, early-career talent, or onboarding.
* Be an **excellent program manager**. You turn ideas into plans, keep many moving pieces organized, and follow through from launch to iteration.
* Be a **skilled facilitator.** You’ve led sessions or trainings and can turn what people need to know into something they learn.
* **Be hands-on with AI.** You experiment with new tools, know when they help, and use them to rethink what our programs can do.
* **Think in systems.** You spot themes across pain points, trace them back to how the program is designed, and solve them systematically.
* Be **creative and comfortable with ambiguity**. Some programs are established, some are new, and you’re energized by figuring out what fits Mercury.
* Be a **clear, warm communicator**. You can welcome someone on day one, run a room, and write a crisp message. You own the details, ask good questions, and stay open to changing your mind.

Experience with **early-career, university, internship, apprenticeship, or employee onboarding programs** is a strong plus.

### **Location and on-site expectations**

This role is hybrid and based in **San Francisco**, home of our apprenticeship program. You’ll spend time in the office with our apprentices and join workshops, programming, and other in-person moments. You’ll also support interns in San Francisco and New York, some in person and some remotely.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

We are Marvell Technical Development, part of the Corporate CTO Office. We believe engineers do their best work when they keep building their skills, can see a clear path ahead, and have the support to strengthen their technical leadership. We develop engineers at every stage of their careers through technical training, technical career development, and technical leadership programs. When we grow our engineers, we grow our future.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Staff Technical Development Program Manager to own technical development programs from end to end, from design through execution and evaluation. You will work closely with engineers, technical mentors, and senior technical leaders. You understand how engineers work and think, and you design programs that fit them. You will thrive in a fast-moving, global environment.

**What You Can Expect**

  

* Own your assigned programs from design to evaluation, including cohort planning, workshops, mentoring, technical projects, events, and delivery.
* Track milestones and key risks to keep execution on schedule and stakeholders aligned. Resolve issues independently within your programs and escalate early when needed.
* Partner with engineering teams to understand their requirements and workflows, and tailor programs to fit how engineers actually work.
* Run needs assessments and gap analyses to identify current and emerging skill and career development needs and use them to prioritize program objectives.
* Develop and deliver technical training for different levels and functions, and localize the global program where needed.
* Facilitate workshops and mentoring sessions using active listening, thoughtful questioning, modeling of key behaviors, visual capture, and coaching of group activities.
* Own the program communication plan, messaging, and branding. Set the tone and key messages, and keep the right stakeholders engaged and informed.
* Define how program effectiveness will be measured. Draft surveys, analyze participants, mentors, and managers for data, and report on participation, satisfaction, and outcomes. Use the results to improve programs and to feed the Technical Talent Intelligence Dashboard.

* Build trusted relationships with technical mentors, engineering managers, executive sponsors, and cross-functional partners to secure buy-in and surface new development needs. Keep goals, deliverables, and timelines clear through regular updates.
* Manage multiple projects in a matrixed, global organization, coordinating across teams and time zones.
* Maintain program infrastructure, including SharePoint and Slack sites, program web pages, toolkits, templates, vendor and budget tracking.
* Support internal technical conferences, contests, and Tech Talks, including speaker coordination and event operations.

**What We're Looking For**

**Education and Overall Experience**

* Bachelor’s with 5 to 10 years of related experience, or Master’s and/or PhD with 2 to 3 years.
Hands-on experience running technical training, career development, or leadership programs end to end.  

  

**Program Design and Learning Expertise**

* Demonstrated experience working directly with engineering teams, with a clear understanding of their mindset, ways of working, and communication preferences; has designed tailored programs to fit how engineers work.
* Solid understanding of learning science, instructional design, adult learning, and performance consulting; has run needs assessments or gap analyses and turned them into program objectives.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (copilots, agents, video generation, eLearning authoring) to design, build, and analyze programs and to produce learning content.

**Program Execution and Operations**

* Deadline-driven and self-directed; manages multiple projects across teams and time zones in a matrixed, global organization, tracks milestones and risks, makes sound decisions under pressure, and creates structure where none exists.
* Proven ability to influence, inspire, and build trusted relationships with engineers, managers, mentors, and executive sponsors, backed by excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication; able to own a program communication plan, messaging, and branding.
* Analytical mindset: defines success metrics, drafts surveys, and uses participant, mentor, and manager data to evaluate and improve programs; builds roadmaps, practical governance, and measurable outcomes aligned with engineering strategy.
* Experience managing program websites, templates, vendors, and budgets.

**Preferred**

* Experience at a technology or semiconductor company.
* Proven experience as a facilitator of workshops and discussions.

118,820 - 178,000, $ per annum

jobs.title: Scaled Account Manager, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Nonprofits, universities and other mission-driven organizations do some of the hardest work in the world, usually with small teams and little technical capacity. As a Scaled Account Manager in Beneficial Deployments, you will be the person a named book of these organizations can rely on. You will own each customer relationship after the first conversation, including commercials, activation and the conversations that turn a new deployment into everyday use.

This role sits on the Scaled Sales team within Beneficial Deployments, the part of Anthropic that brings Claude to mission-driven organizations sooner and further than the market would on its own. You will work with little to no dedicated Customer Success support, so you are both the seller and the person who helps a customer get real value.

That is only possible if you work differently. You will use Claude to take on the short-horizon tasks that consume a book like this, and spend your time on strategic conversations. The role will also change. As we automate more of this work, the book will take less of your time, and that time moves to growth: deeper work with your highest-potential accounts, launches, events and programs that reach many more organizations. We are hiring someone who wants that: someone who will automate parts of their own job and move on to the next hard problem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Own a named book of nonprofit and education customers.** Take over existing relationships and run them end to end: retention, seat growth, plan moves and new contacts inside each organization.
* **Drive activation yourself.** Help priority customers in the segment go from purchased seats to weekly use, starting with where staff lose the most time: fundraising, grant writing, reporting and program operations at nonprofits, or research support, teaching and administration in higher ed.
* **Automate your own work.** Use Claude to handle account research, follow-ups, usage reviews and routine questions, then share what works so the whole team can use it.
* **Spend your time on strategic conversations.** Work with executive directors, operations leads, and IT and academic leaders at universities to find the use cases that matter to their mission and agree what success looks like.
* **Spot who is ready for more.** Identify customers moving from individual productivity toward redesigned workflows, build the case, and bring in Applied AI or other specialists when they qualify for deeper support.
* **Build programs, not one-offs.** When ten customers have the same problem, create a playbook, webinar or cohort that solves it once.
* **Be the voice of your book.** Bring what you hear to Product, Marketing, Support and Operations, and work across those teams to get customer problems fixed.

**Where your time goes as we automate**
---------------------------------------

The role starts mostly account-facing. Over roughly the first six months, we expect Claude to take on much of the routine work, and your time shifts toward growth. Examples of where it goes:

* **Deeper with priority accounts.** Spend real time with the 10 to 15% of your book that can move from individual productivity to redesigned workflows, and get them there.
* **Quarterly launches.** Beneficial Deployments brings new offerings to the nonprofit and education community each quarter. Help drive them: coordinate across Marketing, Comms and partner teams, and make sure your customers benefit.
* **Events.** Help shape and run the events, local and eventually international, that become a core part of how we reach new organizations.
* **New signups and scaled partnerships.** Contribute to the motions that bring new organizations onto Claude, including partner channels and programs for segments we don't yet serve well.

The exact mix will change, and you will help decide it. Part of the job is working out which tasks should be automated and which still deserve a person's time.

**You may be a good fit if you have**
-------------------------------------

* 3+ years of account management or customer success experience with nonprofit or higher education customers, with a proven track record of growing retention and driving adoption of new technology
* Have owned customer relationships in an account management or customer success role, and can point to accounts you grew, retained or turned around
* Use AI in your own work today, and can show a workflow you built that gave you real time back
* Bring structure to unfamiliar problems, and can move from a messy situation to a clear plan quickly
* Have run multi-step programs or projects with several stakeholders and kept them on track
* Have got things done through people you did not manage, across teams in a larger organization
* Stay effective when your job changes, and would see automating part of your role as a win
* Can explain AI plainly to people who are skeptical, busy or new to it
* Care about the mission of nonprofits and educational institutions, and about AI being developed and deployed safely

**Strong candidates may also**
------------------------------

* Have built something from zero, such as a company, a product, a sales motion or a new program, or been an early employee at a startup
* Have a consulting background, with experience across many sectors and problem types
* Have worked at an AI-native company or sold AI products, or moved from business development into owning accounts
* Have worked in or with nonprofits, foundations, Universities or other mission-driven organizations
* Understand how nonprofits

jobs.description:
**About LegalZoom**

LegalZoom is on a mission to help people navigate the legal system with confidence and clarity. As a leader in online legal services for over 25 years, we combine technology, attorney-led solutions, and expertise to protect the aspirations, lives, and legacies of millions of customers. If you’re ready to contribute to a collaborative, diverse, and distributed group of creative thinkers and problem-solvers, we can’t wait to meet you.

**Human-in-the-Loop**

At LegalZoom, we operate with a **human-in-the-loop model**, where AI enhances—rather than replaces—human judgment. We believe the strongest outcomes for our customers come from thoughtfully integrating human expertise with AI capabilities to improve accuracy, safety, and decision-making.

To align with our AI-integrated operating model, our interview process will assess AI fluency, curiosity, and measurable/impactful workflow integration.

**Where we work**  
Our Austin, Beaverton, Frisco, Los Angeles Metro, and San Francisco Bay Area offices allow our employees to collaborate with teammates and offer special onsite events, lunches, and more.

This position is remote but must be based near one of our Los Angeles, Austin, Beaverton, or Mountain View offices. We encourage and at times, require in-person collaboration at our offices.

**Overview**

The Vendor Manager, Performance & Compliance holds LegalZoom’s third-party registered agent (RA) and virtual mail (VM) vendor partners to our quality standards and keeps our customer records accurate and compliant. These vendors accept service of process for our RA customers and receive and handle mail for our virtual mail customers, so consistent vendor performance and accurate records are key to protecting our customers across both services.

Part of the RA and VM Vendor Quality and Vendor Management team and reporting to the Senior Manager, Quality & Vendor Management, this role turns quality results into action with RA and virtual mail vendors and owns compliance and record keeping for customer address changes and resignations. You’ll partner closely with our quality, vendor strategy, enablement, and support teams. This role is remote, based near one of our Los Angeles, Austin, Beaverton, Frisco, or Mountain View offices, with occasional travel to vendor sites.

**You will**

* Own vendor quality performance across the RA and virtual mail vendor network, reviewing results with vendors on a regular cadence
* Take quality findings back to RA and virtual mail vendors with clear expectations and resolution targets, and drive corrective action through to closure
* Partner with the quality team on scorecards and trends, and with the enablement team on targeted retraining
* Escalate repeat or high-risk vendor performance issues to the vendor strategy team with a clear recommendation
* Own compliance and record keeping for customer address changes and resignations, making sure records are accurate with the states and in our internal systems
* Develop and maintain the strategy and processes for resignations and future address changes
* Lead data cleanup efforts, including work with external partners, to keep customer records accurate
* Stay current on state and regulatory requirements that affect RA and virtual mail operations, and partner with Legal on regulatory questions
* Track and report vendor quality and compliance metrics across RA and virtual mail, such as findings closed on time, vendor performance trends, and address-change turnaround
* Continuously improve quality and compliance processes, using AI tools to analyze trends and scale follow-up, with careful human review of every output
* Engage in growth-focused assignments, one-time projects, and cross-functional collaboration that contribute to department and organizational goals

**You have**

* 5+ years of experience in vendor quality, compliance, partner management, or operations, ideally in a regulated or compliance-driven environment
* Experience managing external partner performance, including performance reviews, corrective action plans, and holding partners accountable to standards
* Strong attention to detail and experience maintaining accurate records in a regulated setting
* The ability to use data and quality insights to identify trends, set clear expectations, and measure improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort leading difficult conversations with vendors and presenting results to functional leaders
* Sound judgment on moderately complex problems that require weighing a variety of factors, and the ability to escalate effectively when needed
* A process-improvement mindset and experience documenting SOPs and playbooks
* AI fluency: comfort using AI tools to analyze data and improve workflows, with careful human review of the results
* Familiarity with registered agent services, Secretary of State filings, virtual mail or mail-handling operations, or other regulated document-handling work is a plus
* Commitment to professional development through LZ provided resources and approved platforms, aligned with career progression goals
