**Summary**

  

The SOC Service Delivery Manager serves as the primary customer success leader for assigned Managed Security Services customers and is accountable for service performance, security governance, customer health, adoption, incident communications, and value realization. The role translates cybersecurity operations into meaningful business outcomes by building executive relationships, proactively managing customer health, and helping customers realize value from their partnership with Logicalis.

  
  
  

The role connects customers with Security Operations teams and aligns technical delivery with business priorities, security objectives, contractual commitments, and desired outcomes. The SOC Service Delivery Manager partners with SOC analysts, security engineers, solution architects, Account Executives, Customer Success leaders, and customer stakeholders to strengthen customer confidence, improve security outcomes, and support retention and long-term partnership success.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

*Customer Success, Relationship and Health Management*

  

* Serves as the primary operational relationship owner and trusted advisor for assigned Managed Security Services customers, builds relationships with executive sponsors and customer stakeholders, and maintains an understanding of each customer’s business objectives, security priorities, compliance requirements, risks, opportunities, and success measures.

  

* Aligns service delivery and continuous improvement to desired outcomes; monitors customer health, engagement, adoption, satisfaction, operational risk, and renewal risk; develops mitigation and service improvement plans for at-risk customers; and translates performance data into business insights and recommendations that support retention and renewal readiness.

  

*Security Service Delivery, Governance and Value*

  

* Owns the customer delivery experience for assigned Managed Security Services accounts and leads service reviews, business reviews, executive reviews, and security performance discussions to ensure alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, and desired outcomes.

  

* Reviews and communicates SLA performance, operational effectiveness, security trends, customer sentiment, performance measures, risks, and improvement opportunities in language appropriate for executive, business, and technical stakeholders, while driving accountability for commitments, remediation plans, operational deliverables, service quality, adoption, and customer value.

  

*Security Incident, Escalation and Problem Management*

  

* Serves as the primary customer communication lead during critical security incidents, significant service-impacting events, and escalations, and coordinates SOC analysts, security engineers, vendors, Account Executives, and other stakeholders through resolution with timely, accurate, and transparent communications.

  

* Translates technical findings, threat data, and business risk into executive-level communications and recommendations; leads escalations and post-incident reviews; analyzes incident and escalation trends; and tracks corrective actions to completion to reduce recurring customer friction.

  

*Onboarding, Adoption and Continuous Improvement*

  

* Leads the customer-facing transition of new Managed Security Services from implementation into steady-state operations by managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and stakeholder communications, and validates service configuration, monitoring, documentation, communication plans, escalation procedures, support processes, and stakeholder alignment.

  

* Ensures customers understand available services, responsibilities, support processes, reporting capabilities, governance structures, and escalation paths; identifies adoption barriers and operational gaps; and partners with Security Operations leadership to improve reporting, governance, operational efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

  

*Cross-Functional Leadership and Commercial Management*

  

* Orchestrates technical, customer success, sales, professional services, vendor, and partner stakeholders around customer priorities; establishes ownership and accountability; and maintains customer documentation, governance records, service procedures, operational artifacts, and communications.

  

* Supports service expansions, integrations, technology changes, migrations, and operational improvements; maintains knowledge of customer contracts, service scope, entitlements, and commercial commitments; and partners with Account Executives and Customer Success teams on account strategy, renewals, adoption, service enhancements, and expanded security capabilities aligned to customer needs.

  

*General*

  

* Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.

  

* Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.

  

* Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities but requires leadership and influence across cross-functional teams.

Hawthorne Health is a leading community site network and home research visit solution provider, with 20+ sites and more than 2,000 research experienced healthcare professionals across the U.S. Hawthorne leverages convenient, trusted, healthcare locations, identified patient data, and intelligent technology to accelerate patient access, improve retention, and reduce study costs. By embedding high-quality research within local communities, Hawthorne makes clinical trials more accessible and convenient for patients. Our community-based model shortens timelines and helps bring better treatments to market, faster.

### **About the Role**

Hawthorne Health is expanding access to clinical research through community-based partnerships. The Clinical Site Partnerships & Enablement Manager will identify, evaluate, secure, and support community site partnerships that align with Hawthorne Health’s model and mission.

This person will guide prospective partners through the partnership journey—from initial outreach and fit assessment through lease negotiations, onboarding, launch, and ongoing relationship management. They will own lease negotiations for partner sites, collaborating with the Chief Financial Officer, internal stakeholders, and Legal Counsel when needed. They will also serve as the primary Hawthorne Health contact for site owners and staff, coordinating with internal teams to help each partner launch successfully, operate in accordance with applicable requirements, and have a positive experience.

* Coordinate with Feasibility and other stakeholders to assess site capabilities, patient populations, staffing, space, workflow, and readiness.

* Experience developing external partnerships and managing relationships with healthcare providers, pharmacies, community organizations, or other healthcare sites.

jobs.title: Customer Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Training Specialist is a cross-trained product expert who delivers hands-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.

You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.

You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

**What You'll Do ️**

**Training Delivery**

* Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go-live readiness.
* Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
* Cross-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
* Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

**Account Intelligence & Preparation**

* Pre-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
* Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
* Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

**Team Coordination & Travel**

* Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
* Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in-person where context and environment make it more effective.
* Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
* Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

**Who You Are ‍**

Must Haves:

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
* **Instinct Software Experience:** Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
* **Customer-Facing Training or Education:** 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast-paced environment.
* **CRM & Call Intelligence Tools:** Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
* **Travel Availability:** Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $55,000 - $70,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

jobs.description:
**The Role**

You will be the operations engine behind our COO and CCOs. You will run our project management in Monday.com, own the regulatory calendar for every client, and give our CCOs the support they need to get filings and reviews done right and on time.

**Your path is to become a CCO, and we will train you.** This is not a dead-end admin job. You will learn broker-dealer, investment adviser and fund compliance from people who have sat in the CEO, CCO, COO and FINOP seats. As you grow, you will take on more of the compliance work yourself, add registrations, and build toward a CCO seat of your own.

**Who You Are**

You might be an administrator or project manager in financial services today, or a compliance professional who has not held a CCO seat yet. Either way, you want a career in compliance and you are ready to learn.

* **Team-first:** You share what you know, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate the wins together.

**What You Will Do**

Project Management & Regulatory Calendar

* Run the regulatory calendar for every client, covering deadlines such as FOCUS reports, annual audits, Form ADV amendments, Form CRS updates, Forms N-PORT and ATS-R, FINRA Rule 4530 statistics, FINRA Rule 3130 certifications and state renewals.
* Take in new compliance projects (membership applications, exam requests, annual reviews, AML tests, marketing reviews), break them into tasks and assign each one to the right person.

* Maintain records: save submission confirmations, review sign-offs and meeting notes so every client stays exam-ready.
* Manage calendars, schedule client meetings, take AI-assisted notes and send action items within one business day.
* Keep client files in Google Drive organized, and protect confidential and nonpublic personal information under our Regulation S-P procedures.

Learning the CCO Seat

* Work toward additional registrations, such as the Series 7 and Series 24, with our support.

* **2+ years** in an administrative, project management, operations or compliance role, ideally in financial services.
* **Monday.com skills:** You build boards, automations, dashboards and integrations, not just use them.
* **Excellent with Claude and Gemini:** You use both every day to draft, summarize and organize, you write strong prompts, you set up Claude Projects, and you check AI output for accuracy before it goes to anyone.
* **Google Workspace pro:** Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Meet are second nature.
* Highly organized, discreet with confidential information, and a clear, concise writer.

Big Pluses

* Experience at a broker-dealer, RIA, fund administrator or compliance consulting firm.
* Familiarity with filings such as FOCUS, Form ADV, Form CRS and Form U4/U5.
* Additional registrations, such as the Series 7, 63, 65 or 66.
* Monday.com certification, or a PMP or CAPM project management certification.
* CRM experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot or Salesforce.

We are not an "old school" compliance shop. We find the path to yes, we use modern tools and AI every day, and we like working together. Our clients range from Bitcoin ETFs and crypto RIAs to broker-dealers running ATS and private placement platforms.

**Stay Steady. Stay Compliant.**

jobs.title: Field Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**About HG Insights**
---------------------

HG Insights gives B2B go-to-market teams the data to find, size and win their best markets. Our platform covers technology installs, IT spend, intent and buyer signals, delivered through the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, and our MCP server and AI agents. Through TrustRadius, we also bring the Customer Voice to buyers and vendors.

**The team:** Field and Customer Enablement sits in Product Marketing. We own how HG teaches its product, inside and out: training for our sellers and CSMs, and the HG Insights Academy for customers and partners. You'll join a team led by Sam Brace, alongside a Customer Education Manager and two Enablement Interns.

**The role**
------------

As Field Enablement Manager, you'll run the day-to-day enablement program for everyone at HG Insights who faces customers: Account Executives, Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), BDRs, and Customer Success Managers. You keep the weekly GTM Enablement session, new-hire onboarding, and launch readiness running, so sellers and CSMs always know what's new, why it matters, and how to show it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll build the content, host the sessions, and run the programs, working closely with Sales and CS leaders and with Product Marketing. You report to Sam Brace, Director of Field Enablement and Customer Education.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run the weekly GTM Enablement session.** Plan, build and host it each week, then publish the recording, slides and highlights to the global GTM Slack channel.
* **Own Flockjay programs.** Build and assign courses, assessments and hands-on assignments. Track completion and share leaderboards and team breakouts with Sales and CS leaders.
* **Onboard and ramp new hires.** Run onboarding and ramp plans for AEs, SDRs/BDRs and CSMs, including internal certificate and badging programs on the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, MCP and AI Agents, and our Customer Voice and TrustRadius offerings.
* **Make launches field-ready.** Work with Product Marketing to turn launch materials into talk tracks, demo scripts, objection handling and battlecards, so the field is trained before each release.
* **Build CSM-specific enablement.** Create adoption plays, renewal and expansion conversation guides, and guidance on positioning HG Insider sessions and Academy classes with accounts.
* **Keep the content library current.** Update the enablement library after each release and retire outdated assets.
* **Report on impact.** Share monthly completion, certification and ramp metrics, and bring gaps to Sam and GTM leaders.
* **Support live events.** Help run enablement at sales kickoff and other in-person training as needed.
* **Direct intern work** on field enablement tasks.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 3 to 5 years in sales or customer success enablement, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data company.
* Hands-on experience with an enablement platform such as Flockjay, Highspot, Seismic or Mindtickle.
* Confidence presenting live to sales and CS audiences, and a track record of building content that reps actually use.
* Comfort editing video content with production and post-production tools such as Descript or Camtasia.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and explain it in business terms.
* Clear written English and the ability to work regular hours that overlap with US business hours, since live sessions run on US time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience as a quota-carrying seller or CSM.
* Knowledge of GTM data, technographics or intent products.
* Experience using AI tools (such as Claude) to speed up content and reporting.
* Experience running onboarding or certification programs for a global sales team.

**What we offer/Benefits**
--------------------------

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.  
  
We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

new_jobs.title: Commercial Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Are you the kind of Project Manager who can turn chaos into coordination, problems into solutions, and a complicated flooring installation into a job well done?

If you're nodding your head, we need to talk!

At Profloors, we're not just in the flooring business. We're in the business of building relationships, delivering exceptional results, and making our partners' lives Bigger, Better, and Brighter!

We're looking for an experienced, motivated, and highly organized Commercial Flooring Project Manager to join our Hayward team. This role combines estimating, sales, and project management, with responsibility for developing opportunities, preparing accurate bids, winning work, and managing projects through completion.

This isn't a position for someone who simply checks boxes and watches the clock. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates challenges, builds relationships, and takes pride in seeing a project through from beginning to end.

If you know commercial flooring, enjoy building customer relationships and winning new business, and love the satisfaction of a successful installation, you might just be our next Proflooristic superstar!

What You'll Be Doing

As our Commercial Flooring Project Manager, you'll guide customers from the initial site visit and estimate through proposal approval, installation, and final walkthrough. You'll be responsible for growing sales while ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the high standards our customers expect.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Estimate Accurately: Conduct site visits, measure spaces, review plans and specifications, and prepare material takeoffs and estimates that account for labor, materials, prep, waste, freight, and site conditions.
* Build Complete Proposals: Obtain supplier and subcontractor pricing, confirm product availability and lead times, and prepare clear proposals with scope, exclusions, and project requirements.
* Grow Sales: Develop new business through sales stops, prospecting, referrals, and outreach to property managers, general contractors, and other commercial customers while expanding existing accounts.
* Follow Through and Close: Present flooring solutions, follow up consistently on proposals, address customer questions, and secure written approvals before moving projects into production.
* Keep Your Pipeline Current: Maintain accurate customer contacts, opportunity stages, and next steps in the CRM so every active opportunity has a clear follow-up plan.
* Own Your Projects: Oversee commercial flooring projects from initial opportunity and estimating through installation and final walkthrough.
* Keep Everything Moving: Coordinate installers, customers, internal teams, and schedules to ensure projects run smoothly.
* Be the Problem Solver: Identify potential obstacles, resolve jobsite challenges, and keep projects on track.
* Protect the Bottom Line: Develop competitive pricing that meets company profitability expectations, monitor project costs, and document scope changes and change orders for approval before additional work proceeds.
* Deliver Quality: Conduct in-progress inspections and final walkthroughs to ensure workmanship meets our expectations.
* Build Relationships: Maintain strong communication with customers, address concerns promptly, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Keep Everyone in the Loop: Partner with our administrative team to ensure project notes, orders, and updates are accurate and timely.
* Finish Strong: Take pride in completing projects successfully and creating customers who want to work with Profloors again.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

We're looking for someone who brings more than experience to the table. We want someone who brings initiative, accountability, and a genuine passion for getting things done right.

Here's what you'll need:

* At least one year of flooring industry experience, with a solid understanding of flooring products and installation processes.
* At least one year of project management experience, preferably in commercial flooring or a closely related construction environment.
* Hands-on estimating experience, including site measurements, plan reading, material takeoffs, and labor and material cost calculations.
* Sales and business development experience, with the ability to build relationships, present proposals, follow up consistently, and close profitable work.
* Proficiency with estimating software and CRM tools; experience with Measure Square, M2, or Pipedrive is a plus.
* Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency is a plus but not required.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* The ability to make decisions, solve problems, and remain professional under pressure.
* A valid driver's license and a clean driving record.
* A customer-first mindset and a commitment to quality workmanship.

And just as important, we're looking for someone who:

* Takes accountability instead of making excuses.
* Communicates proactively rather than waiting for someone to ask.
* Understands that details matter and follow-through is everything.
* Treats customers, coworkers, and installers with professionalism and respect.
* Can work independently while recognizing that teamwork makes everyone more successful.

Patient & Family Care Coordinator

**Part-Time | Tuesday–Thursday**  
**Flourish Airway Collective | Danville, California**

Help children breathe, sleep, grow—and flourish.

Flourish Airway Collective is looking for an exceptionally warm, organized, and dependable person to become the welcoming heart of our practice.

This is not a traditional front-desk position. Our Patient & Family Care Coordinator will guide families through their Flourish experience—from the first phone call through treatment and follow-up. The right person will genuinely love connecting with children and their parents, take pride in remembering the little details, and make every family feel seen, supported, and confident in their care.

At Flourish, we help infants, toddlers, children, and adolescents with concerns that may affect their breathing, sleep, feeding, speech, dental development, and overall well-being. Our services include evaluation and treatment of tethered oral tissues, such as tongue-ties and lip-ties, as well as early orthodontic expansion to create more space for the teeth and tongue and support healthy airway development.

Our work can be life-changing for children—and we want every family’s experience with us to feel just as exceptional as the care they receive.

**Who You Are**

You are naturally warm, reassuring, and wonderful with both children and adults. Parents feel comfortable asking you questions because you listen carefully, communicate clearly, and never make them feel rushed or dismissed.

You are also highly detail-oriented. You notice what needs to be done, follow through without repeated reminders, and understand that small details matter—especially when families are navigating unfamiliar treatment.

You bring both heart and ownership to your work. You do not simply complete tasks; you make sure each family is truly taken care of.

**What You’ll DoCreate an Exceptional Family Experience**

* Warmly welcome children and parents when they arrive
* Help children feel comfortable, safe, and excited to visit Flourish
* Build genuine relationships with parents and caregivers
* Anticipate families’ needs and make each visit feel personal and organized
* Serve as a consistent, trusted point of contact throughout treatment
* Create thoughtful touches that make families feel especially cared for

**Communicate With Warmth and Confidence**

* Answer incoming phone calls with warmth, patience, and professionalism
* Listen carefully to parents’ questions and concerns
* Clearly explain what families can expect at upcoming appointments
* Become well trained in Flourish services, terminology, and treatment pathways
* Know when to answer a question, when to gather additional information, and when to involve a clinical team member
* Return calls, texts, and emails promptly and reliably
* Communicate in a way that is friendly, polished, compassionate, and easy to understand

**Coordinate Patient Care**

* Schedule consultations, treatment appointments, and follow-up visits accurately
* Help families understand the next steps in their child’s care
* Confirm that required forms, records, photographs, referrals, and other information are received
* Track outstanding tasks and follow up until they are fully completed
* Coordinate communication with pediatricians, ENTs, myofunctional therapists, speech therapists, lactation consultants, and other collaborative providers
* Prepare and organize patient materials, referral information, and educational resources
* Help prevent families from getting lost between appointments or stages of care

**Support the Growth of Flourish**

* Maintain accurate, organized patient records and tracking systems
* Assist with correspondence, letters, reports, and follow-up communication
* Help deliver educational materials or thoughtful packages to referring offices and community partners
* Support outreach efforts and relationships with local healthcare providers
* Look for ways to improve the family experience and practice systems
* Step in wherever needed to help Flourish run smoothly and beautifully

**What We’re Looking For**

* An exceptionally warm and welcoming personality
* A genuine love of children and appreciation for the parents who care for them
* Experience working with children, parents, or families
* Excellent phone presence and confident interpersonal communication
* Strong attention to detail and an unusually high level of follow-through
* The ability to learn new concepts and explain them clearly
* Emotional intelligence, good judgment, and discretion
* A calm, reassuring presence when parents feel worried or overwhelmed
* Strong written communication and organizational skills
* Comfort managing multiple priorities without losing track of details
* Initiative and the ability to recognize what needs to be done
* Reliability, accountability, and pride in doing things well
* A collaborative, positive, and team-oriented attitude
* Comfort receiving feedback and continually improving

**Especially Valuable Experience**

We would be particularly excited to meet candidates who have:

* Worked in pediatric dentistry, orthodontics, pediatrics, therapy, education, childcare, hospitality, or another family-centered setting
* Experience guiding parents through healthcare, educational, or developmental services
* Professional or lived experience that provides a deep understanding of the questions, emotions, and logistics caregivers navigate
* Experience with treatment coordination, scheduling, patient communication, or referral relationships
* An interest in children’s breathing, sleep, feeding, speech, oral development, or whole-child health
* Experience with community outreach or building relationships with professional offices

Dental experience is helpful but not required. Warmth, judgment, curiosity, attention to detail, and follow-through are essential. We are happy to teach the clinical information to someone who is eager to learn and deeply committed to our fam

new_jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.  
  
The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.  
  
The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.  
  
Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.  
  
Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

### **The Role**

Own technical enablement end to end for our presales Solutions Architects (SAs) and post-sales Customer Solutions Engineers (CSEs) — the single person accountable for the field's technical readiness. You own onboarding and ramp, feature launch enablement, golden demo paths, the demo environment, certification, and the content and metrics that hold it together, so the whole field can represent the platform accurately and win on technical merit. * **Certification & competency.** Define what "good" looks like across levels, certify readiness rather than assume it, gate solo customer-facing moments on it, and coach the field toward the next level with structured feedback.
* **Content & measurement.** Keep one source of truth current by default, and report ramp time, launch coverage, certification, and PoV technical-win conversion against a baseline.

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

* 5+ years in technical enablement, sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical product marketing — ideally having both carried a technical field role and built programs for one.
* A strong technical foundation in application security, software supply chain security, or developer tooling (SCA, SAST / AI code security, CI/CD, integrations) — enough to earn field credibility and translate capability into field-ready assets.
* Fluency with the technical sales motion: discovery, demos, PoVs / PoCs, value/ROI and competitive positioning.

* Familiarity with call analytics (e.g., Gong) and CRM / PoV data for measuring field impact.
* Experience standing up a certification or competency program from scratch.
* Background selling or supporting security tooling to security and engineering leaders.

**What We Offer You**

The ideal candidate is a natural leader who thrives in a fast-paced retail environment, has a strong business mindset, and understands the importance of delivering a high-touch customer experience. **Job Purpose**

The purpose of the Operations Manager is to lead and inspire a team that helps brides find their dream dress while ensuring the business operates efficiently and profitably.

This person will serve as the bridge between leadership, sales, administration, inventory, and alterations. They will proactively identify operational challenges, develop creative solutions, establish accountability, and ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.

We are looking for someone who doesn't simply oversee daily tasks, but takes initiative, anticipates needs, solves problems, and consistently looks for ways to improve the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Multi-Location Operations & Leadership

* Oversee the daily operations of both the Alameda and San Francisco boutiques.
* Maintain a primary presence at the Alameda location while regularly supporting and overseeing the San Francisco team.
* Ensure both locations follow consistent operating procedures, service standards, and company policies.
* Create systems and processes that improve efficiency, communication, and accountability across both locations.
* Ensure all departments are functioning seamlessly, including sales, administration, inventory, and alterations.
* Identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions.
* Ensure opening, closing, daily checklists, and operational procedures are consistently completed.
* Monitor staffing needs and ensure appropriate coverage at both locations.
* Conduct regular check-ins and communicate with the leadership team at each location.

2. Sales Performance & Business Growth

* Work closely with the CEO to establish and execute sales goals and business objectives.
* Monitor sales performance, conversion rates, average transaction values, and other key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Develop strategies to increase sales, appointment bookings, customer retention, and overall profitability.
* Train and coach sales consultants to maximize their performance and deliver exceptional bridal experiences.
* Identify opportunities to increase store traffic and attract new customers.
* Review sales reports and identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Hold the team accountable for meeting individual and store-wide sales goals.
* Help create sales initiatives, promotions, and strategies that align with the boutique's brand and business goals.

3. Team Management & Development

* Lead, motivate, and inspire a positive, professional, and customer-focused team.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop new employees.
* Establish clear expectations and accountability for all team members.
* Conduct regular employee check-ins, performance reviews, and coaching sessions.
* Identify employee strengths and areas for improvement and create development plans.
* Address employee performance concerns, scheduling issues, and workplace conflicts professionally.
* Foster a collaborative environment where team members support one another.
* Create a culture of ownership, professionalism, positivity, and exceptional service.
* Lead by example through strong work ethic, reliability, and attention to detail.

4. Alterations Department Oversight

* Ensure the alterations department operates efficiently and maintains high standards of organization and cleanliness.
* Oversee alterations workflows, timelines, scheduling, and communication.
* Ensure seamstresses have the necessary supplies, materials, tools, and resources to perform their work.
* Monitor alterations progress and help prevent delays or missed deadlines.
* Ensure clear communication between sales consultants, seamstresses, and brides.
* Help resolve alterations-related customer concerns and scheduling challenges.
* Establish systems to track dresses, fittings, deadlines, and outstanding alterations.
* Ensure the alterations workspace remains clean, organized, and professional.

5. Customer Experience & Service Excellence

* Ensure every bride receives an exceptional, personalized, and memorable shopping experience.
* Maintain the boutique's luxury service standards across both locations

new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980. Today Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD’s headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides both community development real estate facilities and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low-income US-born high-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** Under the direction of the program supervisor, this position will serve low-income Workforce Innovation Opportunity Act (WIOA) participants to gain job placements, as well as manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs. This position is responsible for interfacing with local employers and training providers, external organizations, and the internal LFCD department, especially the America’s Job Center of California (AJCC) and Business Centers. This position is required to rotate at Berkeley Adult School and LFCD AJCC locations and reports to the Program Supervisor.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Conduct comprehensive participant assessments to develop individualized care management and employment plans that address physical health, behavioral health, substance use disorders, oral health, social determinants of health, career goals, and employment objectives.
* Perform community outreach and engagement activities, including attending resource fairs, distributing promotional materials, recruiting participants, and coordinating referrals to workforce programs, healthcare providers, and social service agencies.
* Facilitate workshops, program orientations, one-on-one and group counseling sessions, and educational activities focused on job readiness, career development, healthy living, self-sufficiency, and goal achievement.
* Assist participants in developing resumes, cover letters, and Individual Employment Plans (IEPs). Provide labor market information, career counseling, interview preparation, job referrals, job placement assistance, and retention services.
* Provide intensive case management services, including intake, eligibility determination, enrollment, assessment, documentation collection, career planning, referral coordination, and follow-up services. Support participants throughout their program participation and provide up to 12 months of employment retention services.
* Coordinate with training providers to facilitate enrollment in approved training programs and ensure Individual Training Account (ITA) requests and related documentation are submitted accurately and promptly.
* Maintain accurate participant records, including daily activity logs, case notes, service documentation, assessments, eligibility records, and data entry into CalJOBS, Care Management Systems (CMS), and other required databases.
* Deliver Community Supports services designed to address health-related social needs and improve participants' overall health, stability, and employment outcomes.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments; provide reminders; arrange transportation; accompany participants to critical medical appointments, community service appointments, and job interviews when appropriate; and assist in resolving barriers to participation.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with employers, healthcare providers, community-based organizations, educational institutions, and workforce development agencies to expand opportunities and resources for participants.
* Identify employment opportunities that offer competitive wages and benefits, conduct employer outreach and orientations, maintain employer relationships, and coordinate On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunities.
* Assist participants in accessing public benefits and supportive services, including Supplemental Security Income (SSI), CalFresh, cash assistance programs, workforce training resources, housing resources, and other community-based services.
* Provide transitional care coordination and employment retention services through participant follow-up, employer engagement, job tracking, and ongoing support to promote long-term employment success.
* Maintain current knowledge of Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), CalAIM, and related workforce and healthcare initiatives. Utilize community partnerships and available resources to improve participant outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, county, and agency regulations, including participant confidentiality requirements, HIPAA standards, workforce development regulations, and funding source requirements.
* Collaborate with colleges, career centers, training providers, healthcare organizations, and county agencies to facilitate participant enrollment, training approvals, service coordination, and successful outcomes.
* Communicate regularly with county departments, workforce development staff, and community partners to ensure program compliance, timely reporting, eligibility verification, and coordinated service delivery.
* Prepare and submit reports, case notes, performance outcomes, and other program documentation in accordance with agency, county, state, and funding source requirements.
* Provide administrative and programmatic support to Directors, Managers, Program Supervisors, and Site Supervisors as needed.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Human Services, Business Administration, Communications, Public Health, or a related field req

**About Pocket**

*At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.*

Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it.

We’ve built an AI-powered device that captures real-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices.

Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet.

**About the Role**

A customer might need help with a delivery, a device or a recording that has not synced. Good support needs to understand all three, and make the answer feel like it comes from one company.

You’ll own Pocket’s support function: the team, systems, quality and the AI agent already handling routine requests. You’ll also develop our customer community, turning existing engagement into useful conversation, advocacy and retention. This is hands-on work. You’ll coach people, configure the helpdesk and spend time with customers yourself.

**What You’ll Own**

* The AI support agent, knowledge base and automation that resolve routine needs and leave people able to focus on more complex cases.
* The support stack: helpdesk, integrations, routing and reporting.
* A distributed support and community team, including hiring, coaching, schedules and performance.
* Service quality and SLAs, alongside returns, warranties, order issues and escalations.
* The customer-feedback loop into product and operations, so recurring problems lead to fixes.
* Support measures such as deflection, cost per contact, response and resolution time, and CSAT, alongside community growth and its relationship to retention.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Support automation you have shipped, with evidence of how the results changed.
* Experience leading a support team of at least five people at a consumer company, ideally across hardware and software.
* The ability to troubleshoot device and software issues and translate clearly between customers and engineering.
* Comfort configuring tools, working with AI and running effective one-to-ones.
* Ownership of metrics and the systems behind them, without needing constant direction.
* Clear writing, good customer judgment and calm execution through launches, delays and spikes in demand.

**Why Join Pocket?**

You’ll shape a core part of the customer experience, with direct access to the founders and an existing team and support system to build on. You’ll be able to connect what customers tell you to changes in the product and the way the company works.

Compensation Range: $100K - $180K

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

A Member Care Coordinator sits at the intersection of Member Experience and Clinical Operations. The role of a Member Care Coordinator is to ensure that members receive timely, coordinated, and high quality care; acting as the “glue” between the Clinical, Coaching, and Operational teams. They ensure smooth handoffs between teams, including but not limited to, tracking lab results, medication approvals, and any necessary clinical follow up to ensure members proceed through their journey seamlessly.

**This is a full-time, hourly role with a hourly rate of $20-22 per hour. We are offering two different shifts:**

* 8:00am - 4:30pm ET
* 9:30am - 6:00pm ET
* 10:30am - 7:00pm ET

* Troubleshoot technical or administrative insurance issues that prevent successful claims processing.

* Completion of a formal medical assisting program is highly valued. Preference will be given to candidates who hold a national certification, such as Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) awarded by the AAMA or Registered Medical Assistant (RMA) awarded by the AMT.

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the proven ability to handle challenging, escalated calls/messages with professionalism and empathy.

* Access to several wellness programs, including a complimentary Headspace membership, and therapy on your schedule with Headspace Care.
* Employee Assistance Program through Principal to receive counseling on a wide range of topics.
* Remote-first ways of working, with the flexibility to work from any state.

------------------

Zillow’s Procurement team helps the business move faster and smarter by building trusted supplier partnerships and thoughtful sourcing strategies across the company. Within Strategic Sourcing, you’ll work with cross-functional stakeholders to balance cost, quality, and risk while bringing structure, insight, and innovation to how we buy. This team plays an important role in supporting Zillow’s goals by helping teams make informed decisions and deliver value at scale. Within the team, our Sourcing Center of Excellence also owns the tools and processes behind how we buy, from intake workflows to Source-to-Pay platform configuration, so sourcing stays consistent, compliant, and easy for teams to use.

**About the role**
------------------

The Sourcing Project Manager develops and executes sourcing strategies that optimize total cost, quality, and risk across Zillow’s spend categories. You will also serve as a functional owner of our Sourcing tools and sourcing-enabled processes, blending hands-on deal execution with process ownership, tooling administration, and digital transformation to drive process improvements across the sourcing and intake-to-procure lifecycle while independently managing competitive events, renewals, and new sourcing requests while. You will conduct market and supplier analysis, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate contracts, and partner with stakeholders to deliver value and innovation in support of business objectives.

  

**You will get to**
-------------------

* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Business) to align sourcing plans with budget and business needs, and to ensure sourcing governance, compliance, and audit readiness.
* Support the development of category strategies, sourcing playbooks, and standard tools that promote consistency and compliance.
* Maintain accurate sourcing documentation, contract records, and savings tracking to communicate value delivered to leadership.
* Drive Source-to-Pay tool requirements gathering, workflow configuration, and system enhancements.
* Drive adoption of the supplier segmentation and categorization framework.
* Conduct process mapping and implement workflow improvements that advance digital transformation and process efficiency.
* Apply Agile and Lean methods to sourcing, tooling, and process-improvement initiatives.
* Lead moderately complex strategic sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification through supplier selection and award.
* Analyze spend, demand, and market data to identify sourcing opportunities and inform category strategies.

new_jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Onboarding Manager is the primary point of contact and strategic driver for every hospital going live on Instinct. You are the project lead, the workflow expert, and the trusted advisor all in one — responsible for keeping implementations on track, on time, and on scope while earning the confidence of hospital leadership throughout the process.

This is not a task-management role. You bring executive presence, a strong sense of urgency, and the consultative skill to navigate a hospital's operational complexity while holding them accountable to the milestones that matter. You know that a delayed go-live is a delayed relationship, and you take that seriously.

You own end-to-end project coordination — from kick-off to go-live — working closely with Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, integrations, and internal teams to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience. Your strength is your ability to make every hospital feel like their implementation is the most important project you are running — even when you are managing several simultaneously

**What You'll Do ️**

**Project Leadership & Management**

* Project Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned onboarding projects from signed contract through go-live and handoff to the active CS team.
* Timeline Management: Build, manage, and enforce project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and accountability — targeting go-live within the 8-week SLA.
* Risk & Escalation: Identify project risks proactively and escalate effectively — to the hospital, to the Team Lead, and across internal teams — so nothing sits quietly off track.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate across Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, Integration partners, and Medical Review to keep all workstreams moving in sync.

**Customer Relationship & Consultative Approach**

* Trusted Advisor: Position yourself as a knowledgeable, credible partner throughout the project — not just a task tracker. Help hospital leaders see the full picture of what a successful go-live enables for their team.
* Executive Presence: Communicate confidently and credibly with practice owners, medical directors, and hospital administrators — matching your communication style to the audience while maintaining clarity and urgency.
* Workflow Development: Lead workflow discovery and design sessions with the hospital, translating their current clinical and operational processes into Instinct-configured workflows that fit how their team actually works.
* Sense of Urgency: Keep the hospital engaged and moving — because a delayed implementation is always a risk to go-live. You are skilled at creating accountability without creating friction.

**Technical & Product Coordination**

* Integration Setup: Own the coordination of integrations — including lab, imaging, and pharmacy partners — ensuring technical readiness aligns with the project timeline.
* Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Instinct's product capabilities and configuration options, serving as the go-to resource for workflow questions during onboarding.
* Training Coordination: Coordinate with Training Specialists to ensure training is scoped, scheduled, and delivered at the right point in the project — reinforcing adoption ahead of go-live.

**Who You Are ‍**

**Must Haves:**

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. Direct experience working in or closely with veterinary hospitals — clinical, operational, or administrative.
* **Project Management Experience:** 2–4+ years managing customer-facing implementation or onboarding projects, ideally in SaaS or health technology.
* **Instinct Software Familiarity:** Strongly preferred. Existing knowledge of Instinct's configuration and workflow capabilities accelerates ramp significantly.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated ability to manage relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization, including executives.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable coordinating software integrations, data requirements, and configuration discussions — even without deep technical expertise.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $65,000 - $80,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

*Instinct is an equal opportunity employer committed to equality and providing a pleasant work environment free from harassment

As the **Project Coordinator – Multi-Family Lighting**, you’ll help manage projects from initial documentation through final closeout. You’ll be responsible for keeping project information accurate, organized, and moving forward while proactively communicating with customers and internal teams.

new_jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------

We're hiring another Customer Success Manager to own a book of business across our Pro package clients. You'll be the main point of contact for your accounts from onboarding through renewal, responsible for adoption, retention, and growth. This is a high-ownership role, so you'll touch everything from day-one onboarding to churn saves to surfacing product gaps back to the team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own onboarding for new subscribers, getting accounts to first value fast (creator search, outreach setup, Spark Codes, GMV tracking, campaigns) and running a structured onboarding sequence over the first 60 days
* Manage a portfolio of brand and agency accounts, running regular check-ins and walkthroughs to drive adoption and expansion
* Monitor account health and act on churn signals before they become cancellations, including win-back and retention outreach on at-risk accounts
* Run failed payment recovery and billing follow-up to protect MRR
* Pull and interpret usage and subscription data to prioritize where to spend your time, and report on your book's health
* Capture customer feedback and feature requests, turn them into clear product asks, and track them through to resolution
* Support Reacher Plus clients where managed service and software overlap
* Keep account context, notes, and next steps clean and current
* Join demo calls as the platform expert with the sales team whenever needed

**You'll Be Successful If You**
-------------------------------

* Have 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role
* Have hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop, including strategy, affiliate programs, and automation tools; agency background preferred
* Are a strong communicator who can build rapport quickly and maintain trust over time
* Are comfortable managing clients
* Are highly organized with a bias toward follow-through and accountability
* Thrive in fast-paced startup environments where speed and scrappiness are key

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Black Mountain Dynamics delivers managed IT and cybersecurity services, and the Technical Account Manager is the face of BMX to every client after the sale closes. * QBR ownership: the agenda, roadmap narrative, and strategic message of each business review. Service Delivery brings operational reporting; you ensure it lands inside a coherent story.

* Familiarity with HaloPSA and Hudu.

Relationship-first. You measure success by whether clients feel taken care of — not just whether tickets get closed. You carry the full weight of the BMX relationship on every interaction.

new_jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Training Specialist is a cross-trained product expert who delivers hands-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.

You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.

You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

**What You'll Do ️**

**Training Delivery**

* Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go-live readiness.
* Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
* Cross-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
* Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

**Account Intelligence & Preparation**

* Pre-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
* Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
* Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

**Team Coordination & Travel**

* Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
* Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in-person where context and environment make it more effective.
* Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
* Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

**Who You Are ‍**

Must Haves:

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
* **Instinct Software Experience:** Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
* **Customer-Facing Training or Education:** 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast-paced environment.
* **CRM & Call Intelligence Tools:** Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
* **Travel Availability:** Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $55,000 - $70,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

As the Junior Events and Training Specialist, you'll create and edit event content, training materials, and employee communications that reflect the heart of Classical Conversations — The CC Way — while serving as a welcoming, helpful presence at events. This role blends relational energy with careful craftsmanship: one day you're building rapport with attendees and coworkers, the next you're meticulously proofreading content for Chicago style accuracy. If you love connecting with people as much as you love getting the details right, this is a chance to grow your skills in content creation, event coordination, and classical Christian education — all in service of homeschool families and the broader CC community.

new_jobs.title: Field Enablement Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About HG Insights**
---------------------

HG Insights gives B2B go-to-market teams the data to find, size and win their best markets. Our platform covers technology installs, IT spend, intent and buyer signals, delivered through the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, and our MCP server and AI agents. Through TrustRadius, we also bring the Customer Voice to buyers and vendors.

**The team:** Field and Customer Enablement sits in Product Marketing. We own how HG teaches its product, inside and out: training for our sellers and CSMs, and the HG Insights Academy for customers and partners. You'll join a team led by Sam Brace, alongside a Customer Education Manager and two Enablement Interns.

**The role**
------------

As Field Enablement Manager, you'll run the day-to-day enablement program for everyone at HG Insights who faces customers: Account Executives, Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), BDRs, and Customer Success Managers. You keep the weekly GTM Enablement session, new-hire onboarding, and launch readiness running, so sellers and CSMs always know what's new, why it matters, and how to show it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll build the content, host the sessions, and run the programs, working closely with Sales and CS leaders and with Product Marketing. You report to Sam Brace, Director of Field Enablement and Customer Education.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Run the weekly GTM Enablement session.** Plan, build and host it each week, then publish the recording, slides and highlights to the global GTM Slack channel.
* **Own Flockjay programs.** Build and assign courses, assessments and hands-on assignments. Track completion and share leaderboards and team breakouts with Sales and CS leaders.
* **Onboard and ramp new hires.** Run onboarding and ramp plans for AEs, SDRs/BDRs and CSMs, including internal certificate and badging programs on the HG Platform, Sales Copilot, Market Analyzer, Data Studio, the Fabric, MCP and AI Agents, and our Customer Voice and TrustRadius offerings.
* **Make launches field-ready.** Work with Product Marketing to turn launch materials into talk tracks, demo scripts, objection handling and battlecards, so the field is trained before each release.
* **Build CSM-specific enablement.** Create adoption plays, renewal and expansion conversation guides, and guidance on positioning HG Insider sessions and Academy classes with accounts.
* **Keep the content library current.** Update the enablement library after each release and retire outdated assets.
* **Report on impact.** Share monthly completion, certification and ramp metrics, and bring gaps to Sam and GTM leaders.
* **Support live events.** Help run enablement at sales kickoff and other in-person training as needed.
* **Direct intern work** on field enablement tasks.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 3 to 5 years in sales or customer success enablement, ideally at a B2B SaaS or data company.
* Hands-on experience with an enablement platform such as Flockjay, Highspot, Seismic or Mindtickle.
* Confidence presenting live to sales and CS audiences, and a track record of building content that reps actually use.
* Comfort editing video content with production and post-production tools such as Descript or Camtasia.
* Ability to learn a technical product quickly and explain it in business terms.
* Clear written English and the ability to work regular hours that overlap with US business hours, since live sessions run on US time.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience as a quota-carrying seller or CSM.
* Knowledge of GTM data, technographics or intent products.
* Experience using AI tools (such as Claude) to speed up content and reporting.
* Experience running onboarding or certification programs for a global sales team.

**What we offer/Benefits**
--------------------------

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.  
  
We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.
